name: holesail-gui
description: Desktop GUI for Holesail — share local ports and connect to P2P tunnels
author: chethan62

scripts.lint: eslint renderer/ service-worker.js worker/ test/ scripts/
scripts.lint:fix: eslint renderer/ service-worker.js worker/ test/ scripts/ --fix
scripts.build:android: npm run prepare:android && node scripts/android-glue.mjs && tauri android build --apk --debug
scripts.build:android:release: npm run prepare:android && node scripts/android-glue.mjs && tauri android build --apk
scripts.test: node test/service.test.js && node test/renderer.test.js && node test/units.test.js && node test/fileserver.test.js && node test/invite.test.js && node test/session-state.test.js
scripts.gate: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:bare && node scripts/prepare-resources.mjs --bare --target linux-x64 && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:bare: node scripts/prepare-resources.mjs --bare --target linux-x64 --out dist-resources-bare && WORKER_CMD=dist-resources-bare/bare WORKER_PATH=dist-resources-bare/service-worker.js node test/service.test.js && node test/renderer.test.js
